oracle: Ensembl VEP 115.2 with the official Homo sapiens 115_GRCh38 indexed cache
purpose: All-transcript comparison of a small source-guided regression group; no field exceptions.

fields.name: Existing_variation
fields.reason: Co-located variation data is outside the consequence comparison.

fields.name: REF_ALLELE
fields.reason: fastVEP renders an empty minimized insertion reference as '-' while VEP renders it empty.

fields.name: UPLOADED_ALLELE
fields.reason: fastVEP escapes additional multiallelic separators as '&' while VEP retains '/'.

fields.name: FLAGS
fields.reason: User-approved FLAGS multiset comparison: VEP 115 OutputFactory preserves attribute order, AttributeAdaptor has no ORDER BY, and public dump order differs from the official cache. Values and multiplicity must match; raw reports remain available.
